newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei firms on short-covering at noon.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei firms on short-covering at noon.

text.p: Short-covering triggered by healthy buying in the cash market lifted the SIMEX Nikkei futures at midday on Monday, dealers said.
They added the market was underpinned by early comments made by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor Yasuo Matsushita.
Speaking at the opening of a two-day meeting with BOJ branch managers, Matsushita confirmed the BOJ's accommodative monetary policy.
"Matsushita reiterated there would be no change to Japan's low interest rate policy for now and that is helping Nikkei," said a Japanese dealer.
He added the Nikkei cash market saw short-covering in banking, construction and securites sectors.
Nikkei 225 June contract was locked in a tight 90-point range and was trading around 18,465 at 0300 GMT, up 90 points. Turnover was light, at 4,630 lots.
The April MSCI Taiwan index contract was at 352.1 against its open at 345.2.
